Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
For those of you planning on playing in the qualifier and/or championships
at Gen*Con, be advised that I will be collecting decklists from all
participants. If you bring a printed decklist, that will save some time.

The decklist needs only your name, V:EKN number, and a list of the cards
in your deck.

I will provide blank decklist forms on-site to those who need them.

Also, be sure that your deck matches the decklist you turn in.

Thanks,
Scott

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to V:TES news, rules, cards, utilities, and tournament calendar:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/
